name: 6-iodopravadoline
summary: 1 nM at CB2 and 165x selectivity over CB1, at which it acted as a weak partial agonist. It is used in the study of CB2 mediated responses and has been used to investigate the possible role of CB2 receptors in the brain.

pharmacology.text: AM-630 (6-Iodopravadoline) is a drug that acts as a potent and selective inverse agonist for the cannabinoid receptor CB2, with a Ki of 32.1 nM at CB2 and 165x selectivity over CB1, at which it acted as a weak partial agonist. It is used in the study of CB2 mediated responses and has been used to investigate the possible role of CB2 receptors in the brain.

uses.text: It is used in the study of CB2 mediated responses and has been used to investigate the possible role of CB2 receptors in the brain.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory tool rather than a drug people take, and its effects in people have not been described.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室工具，而不是供人使用的藥物，在人體的作用也沒有相關描述。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室工具，而不是供人使用的药物，在人体的作用也没有相关描述。

fact.en: Better known as AM-630, it is one of the standard laboratory tools for the CB2 cannabinoid receptor, which sits mainly on immune cells rather than in the brain.
fact.zh: 它更常以AM-630之名為人所知，是研究CB2大麻素受體的標準實驗室工具之一；這個受體主要分布在免疫細胞上，而不是腦中。
fact.zhHans: 它更常以AM-630之名为人所知，是研究CB2大麻素受体的标准实验室工具之一；这个受体主要分布在免疫细胞上，而不是脑中。
